name: Countdown
description: Counts down to a time of day or date, or for a duration from when it is shown; shows a message at zero.

params.name: until
params.help: Count to this time: 18:30 (today or the next one) or 2026-12-31T18:30. Wins over duration

params.name: duration
params.help: Or count down this long (seconds or m:ss), from when the layer is shown or the value changes
